summary: tactical jamming pod, its ram-air turbine at the nose (EA-18G: the mid-board wing stations and the centre line)

mass_kg.note: the EA-18G design's own estimate (aircraft/ea18g/ea18g.toml, where the pods were drawn and weighed before they were stores): about 960 lb each

length_m.note: the EA-18G design's own estimate (aircraft/ea18g/ea18g.toml, where the pods were drawn and weighed before they were stores): 4.7 m long, against the AGM-88 beside it in photographs

diameter_m.note: the EA-18G design's own estimate (aircraft/ea18g/ea18g.toml, where the pods were drawn and weighed before they were stores): 0.62 m across

drag_area_m2.note: the isolated store's CD S below Mach 0.8 at a Reynolds number of 1e7 per metre, built up from its design (hangar storedrag.py: Hoerner's body of revolution 0.01771, its base 0.03615, its fins' friction 0.00000 m^2): an estimate by one method for every store

munk_volume_m3.note: its body's unstable moment across a flow, q x this x sin(2 x angle) (Munk, NACA Report 184): its volume 1.3518 m^3 from its design, times Lamb's k2 - k1 = 0.908 for its fineness 7.6 (hangar storedrag.py): an estimate by one method for every store

side_slope_m2.note: its fins' and base's force across it per radian of crossflow, over the dynamic pressure (hangar storedrag.py: one fin pair's Helmbold slope carried onto the body, slender-body theory's base): an estimate by one method for every store

side_arm_m.note: where that force acts, behind the store's CG (hangar storedrag.py: its fins' quarter chords, its base)

wp-ea18g.title: Boeing EA-18G Growler (its jamming load: the design's estimates were made against its photographs)
